QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Kinesis's Message
QuestInfo.0: Kinesis seems embarrassed. Talk to him to get the message.
QuestInfo.1: Kinesis's message is for his friends, #bYuna and \r\nJay#k, at the hideout in Seoul. Take the bus in front of Shinsoo International School to the School for the Gifted, then enter the building on the left to get to the hideout in Seoul. Think you can find your way?
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Kinesis's message to #bYuna and \r\nJay#k! Yuna was a bit skeptical that it was actually from Kinesis at first, but it worked out.

default.0: Take the bus in front of Shinsoo International School to the School for the Gifted, then enter the building on the left to get to the hideout. Easy, right?
